Zum Konflikt zwischen China und Tibet.

Von allen Ländern hat es Tibet am erfolgreichsten verstanden, seine Unabhängigkeit gegen die Unterjochungsgelüste der mächterigen Nachbarstellen zu erhalten. Zur Zeit tagt bekanntlich in Peking die sogenannte tibetanische Konferenz, welche die schwebenden Streitfragen zwischen China und Tibet regeln soll. -

FEAST OF SACRIFICE.
Picturesque Ceremony at Thanksgiving Service of Mohammedans,

The Holborn Restaurant was yesterday the centre of Mohammedan worship in London. The occasion was the annual commemoration of the Sacrifice of Israel, which is celebrated by Mohammedans all over the world.
About 100 members of the Islamic Society attended in Oriental costume. Removing their boots, but retaining their turbans and other headgear, they sat on a floor draped with white cloth.
Then, as the presiding priest offered up the Iduzzoha Prayer, they knelt at intervals and reversently touched the floor with their heads.
Silent meditation followed, and the chanting of a portion of the service, which is a Thanksgiving service for benefits conferred during the past year.

Mohammedans of all races gathered at the Holborn Restaurant yesterday for the prayer which follows the pilgrimage to Mecca. (1) The sermon. (2) The Imam Ahmed Asad Effendi, who led the Iduzzola prayer. This long prayer is delivered in Arabic.—(“Daily Mirror” photographs.)

ECLIPSE OF THE SUN IN INDIA.

People of India used to observe the eclipse not on scientific principles, but as a day of Fast and Religion. When there is an eclipse, the people especially brathmins, will not take even a spoonful of water, but when it is over they take a complete bath, and then sit down for meals.

O.P.S. Thousands of people taking a bath in the Sacred Gauges, after the recent Solar Elipse day in Bombay, India.
